name: IFC export
description: Exports the items on one level to an IFC4 file with chosen project, site, building and storey names.

notes.text: WHAT IT DOES: finds the items whose Element > Level equals the text, then writes them to an IFC4 file with the project, site, building and storey names and the base point wired into Export.ToIfc. TO CHANGE: the level text, the names, the base point (Export.IfcCoordinates) and the file path.
